study: Value of explicit reference roles for benchmark operations
authorization: User approved focusing on three-role assessment value and matched Systema comparison; no manuscript, CURRENT, frozen releases or training changes.
access_history: Retrospective follow-up using previously examined resources, scores and findings. This protocol fixes the present operational cases and reporting before new metric cube and action outputs; it is not prospective or blinded.
question: Does making the three reference roles explicit provide a correct, executable route from a benchmark change to the affected prediction, target and scoring operations?

role_definitions.Cmodel: Untreated-cell input supplied to a fitted predictor. Change can require a new prediction, depending on declared model dependence.
role_definitions.Cpred: Baseline used to define a predicted effect from state output. Unused for emitted native effects and direct treated-state scoring.
role_definitions.Cobs: Baseline defining observed effect. Unused for direct treated-state scoring.
role_definitions.other_artifacts: Storage-encoding baseline, native-effect state lift, metric centre, feature scales and candidate coordinates remain separately declared; they are not automatically any of the three roles.

comparators.definition: Same Systema metric formulas, canonical declared outputs, allocation0/input0 at each depth; reference-effect anchor tuple obs1,pred0,model0. Conventional fixed-realization output is a workflow comparator, not the complete capability of Systema.

Same metric formulas and canonical outputs; every recorded direct-state input and every correctly paired held-out-effect O realization, all30allocations. Same source data, available role metadata and control budget as full-role workflow.

Same metric formulas plus explicit role-dependency plan, all27 balanced role assignments and checked post-change action. Complete role cube is an additional intervention set, not an intrinsically stronger metric.

parity_reference: Systema repeats plus explicit manual role reasoning receive identical metadata and all post-intervention arrays. Their canonical calculations can recover the full-role results; omitting a default diagnostic is unreported, not incorrect. No invented diagnostic accuracy or human time comparison.
